items.question: Which courts have jurisdiction over disputes under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The documents state that the courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of the Kestrel storage agreement. This is specified in the Kestrel storage agreement, which states: "The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement" [1].

No other courts are mentioned as having jurisdiction over disputes under the Kestrel storage agreement.

evidence.quote: The courts of London have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement

items.question: Which law governs the Calder & Wynne engagement?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter does not explicitly state which law governs the engagement. However, the Northbridge NDA specifies that the Agreement is governed by the law of England and Wales [2].

The Harrowgate MSA states that the Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware [3].

The Unit 7 Lease also states that the Lease is governed by the law of England and Wales [4].

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: How quickly must Kestrel notify Voss-Lindqvist of a data breach under the storage agreement?
items.answer:
The documents do not specify how quickly Kestrel must notify Voss-Lindqvist of a data breach under the storage agreement [1][3].

The Harrowgate MSA clause 6.1 states that the provider must notify the client of a data breach within 48 hours of becoming aware of it [3].

However, it is unclear if this clause applies to the storage agreement between Kestrel and Voss-Lindqvist. The storage agreement's liability clause limits the provider's liability to EUR 150,000 per event [1].

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: 5.2 Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.
6.1 Provider shall notify Client of any personal data breach affecting Client Data without undue delay and in any event within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of it.
7.1 Provider's total liability for loss of or damage to stored goods is limited to EUR 150,000 per event.

items.question: How long do confidentiality obligations last under the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer:
The confidentiality obligations under the Kestrel storage agreement are not directly addressed in the provided sources. The Kestrel storage agreement itself does not mention confidentiality terms. An amendment to the Kestrel storage agreement states that all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force [4].

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

items.question: How often does Harrowgate invoice, and is it in advance or in arrears?
items.answer:
Harrowgate invoices monthly in advance. The source states, "Provider shall invoice monthly in advance. Invoices are payable net thirty (30) days from the invoice date" [1].

There is no indication that Harrowgate invoices at any other frequency. The engagement letter from Calder & Wynne also mentions billing monthly, but does not specify whether it is in advance or in arrears [4].

items.question: What makes information Confidential Information under the Northbridge NDA?
items.answer: Under the Northbridge NDA, Confidential Information includes all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential [1].

evidence.quote: Confidential Information means all information disclosed by a Party (the "Discloser") to the other (the "Recipient") in connection with the Purpose, in any form, that is marked confidential or would reasonably be understood to be confidential.

items.question: When is the warehouse rent suspended?
items.answer: The warehouse rent is suspended if the Premises are unfit for use for more than thirty (30) consecutive days because of an event beyond the party's reasonable control [1].

evidence.quote: If the Premises are unfit for use for more than thirty (30) consecutive days because of such an event, the rent shall be suspended until the Premises are fit for use again
